title: Worthless Assembly Instructions/ Faulty Design
text:
Worthless Assembly Instructions/ Faulty Design. This arrived several days ago and I finally assembled it today.

1. The box was severely damaged. Fed Ex had taped it back together, but the bottom insert of the drawer was damaged.
2. Assembling this according to the instructions, which are somewhat nebulous (no text, just pictures and arrows and little juvenile smiley faces), took the better part of 3 hours. So plan accordingly. I have a lot of experience with these kinds of things, so I'm no dummy. No issues with screws or holes. Everything did fit together once it was figured out.
3. The quality is about what you would expect for pressed "wood".
4. Crappy drawer construction. I would not overload the drawer, or put much weight on the upper section of this.
5. The extra USB ports are totally useless if you have a printer sitting in the only place it will fit. The cable won't even reach to the computer if you don't have tower. The USB ports were one of the reasons I got this. Bummer

To summarize, this is pretty much what you would expect for the money. Might last a few years if you don't overload it or try to move it around much.
